unit: one qualified initial claim within one case

labels.supported: The cited frozen evidence supports the claim at its stated scope.
labels.unsupported: The claim contradicts, exceeds, or misuses the cited frozen evidence.
labels.unclear: The frozen evidence is insufficient to decide support.

procedure: Two annotators label independently without seeing method outputs or final recommendation labels.
Disagreements are adjudicated before an update arm is run.
Annotators may use only the frozen evidence bundle and the exact claim scope.
Agreement and disagreement counts are reported; adjudication never uses Hit@5 outcomes.
automation_boundary: Source existence is checked automatically; semantic support is never inferred automatically.
